reasoning: Pointe de la Hague is in Normandy, France. The question asks whether the daily average temperature on November 2, 2025 will exceed that of October 26, 2025 - a 7-day difference in early autumn/late fall. Typically, temperatures decline from late October to early November in northern France as winter approaches. October 26 would generally be warmer than November 2. However, weather is variable, and a warm spell in early November or unseasonably cold weather on October 26 could reverse this. Given the seasonal trend strongly favors October 26 being warmer, but accounting for weather variability, I estimate roughly 35-40% probability that November 2 is warmer.
